title: EEG: First Episode Psychosis vs. Control Resting Task 2
description: Resting-state EEG recordings from healthy controls and individuals with first episode psychosis (FEP), representing the second of two independently collected samples. The dataset includes 5-minute resting recordings acquired with a 60-channel 10-10 cap alongside an Elekta Neuromag Vectorview system, and a phenotype directory with clinical, cognitive, and socioeconomic assessments. Subjects who shared a montage with the first acquisition (Task 1) are excluded here.
methods_description: Resting EEG was recorded for 5 minutes using an Elekta Neuromag Vectorview system with a low-impedance 10-10 system 60-channel cap. Clinical assessments included BPRS, SANS, SAPS, GAF/GAS, SFS, MATRICS, WASI, Hollingshead index, and chlorpromazine-equivalent medication doses.
